notes: The first route's «أبي» is the father of Ubayd Allah, unnamed here: relation link (rule 7); the two routes meet at «قالا جميعا حدثنا شعبة» and the rest is the shared tail (rule 3)
«يحدث أبا بردة في هذا المسجد» : Abu Burda is a listener in the scene, not a link (rule 6)
«هذا حديث ابن معاذ وليس في حديث غندر» is a wording remark (the same route through Ghandar, which is Muhammad b. Ja'far already in the chain): left out, not a variant group
